item.coloph: ces bder gshegs byang sems sku gzugs phyag tshad mkha' gsal nor bu'i me long 'di ni/ ri mo'i byed po rin chen rgyal mtshan dang nye bar rgyal rong gling dgu rgyal po'i mchod gnas dam pa 'bar khams gling gi sku zhabs bsod nams bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ kho bo rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis lcags sprel hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu la rig bzhi'i nang tshan rin chen rigs kyi gnas/ bam brag brtsegs pa rin chen 'bar ba'i mthil/ mtsho steng bde ldan gsang sngags khrod du brtsol pas (brtsams pas) / rgyal bstan nub med srid pa'i sgron ltar dar ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
